- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/subscription` — The tenant's subscription and the features it gives
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts` — The trust anchor: every other tenant with its subscription, newest first
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts/{account_id}` — The trust anchor: one account with its subscription
- `PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts/{account_id}/subscription` — The trust anchor: set an account's subscription
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts/{account_id}/subscription` — The trust anchor: remove an account's subscription (back to the free use)

## The tenant's subscription and the features it gives

`GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/subscription` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [SubscriptionOut](/reference/api/schemas/#subscriptionout) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## The trust anchor: every other tenant with its subscription, newest first

`GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `limit` *(optional)* | query | integer | ≥ 1, ≤ 100, default `20` |
| `cursor` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 300 |
| `q` *(optional)* | query | string or null | max length 100 |
| `subscribed` *(optional)* | query | `yes`, `no` or null | `yes`: those with a subscription in any state; `no`: without |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [AccountPage](/reference/api/schemas/#accountpage) |
| 400 | [`invalid_cursor`](/reference/errors/#invalid_cursor) |
| 403 | [`anchor_only`](/reference/errors/#anchor_only), [`not_admin`](/reference/errors/#not_admin) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |

## The trust anchor: set an account's subscription

`PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts/{account_id}/subscription` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [SubscriptionIn](/reference/api/schemas/#subscriptionin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | string | max length 32 |
| `status` | `active`, `past_due`, `canceled` |  |
| `current_period_end` *(optional)* | string (date-time) or null |  |
| `note` *(optional)* | string or null | max length 1000 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | [AccountOut](/reference/api/schemas/#accountout) |
| 403 | [`anchor_only`](/reference/errors/#anchor_only), [`not_admin`](/reference/errors/#not_admin) |
| 404 | [`account_not_found`](/reference/errors/#account_not_found) |
| 422 | [`plan_invalid`](/reference/errors/#plan_invalid): not one of the plans; [`period_end_invalid`](/reference/errors/#period_end_invalid): an active one's end is already past |
